decisions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

① concealed는 displayed의 반의어
② scattered는 classified의 반의어
③ displayed — classified — conventional ←정답
④ innovative는 conventional의 반의어

decisions.passage:
(A) The teacher <u>marked</u> the students' papers with a red pen, giving each one a grade. She carefully noted every mistake and wrote comments in the margins. It took her the entire evening to finish reviewing all thirty papers.
(B) He displayed a <u>marked</u> interest in science at an early age. His curiosity about the natural world was evident to everyone around him. Even as a child, he spent hours reading about rocks and minerals.
